objective: Mine a fundamental factor family on A-share using the worldquant-5-agent-workflow, one mechanism per batch, monthly rebalance, delay=1.

mechanism_candidates.name: Accruals anomaly (earnings quality)
mechanism_candidates.why: High accruals = low-quality earnings = lower future returns; Sloan 1996 + A-share replications show 3-4% LS premium; data available on free Tushare tier (income/balancesheet/cashflow).
caveats: Must use ann_date (announcement), not end_date (period) for publication-lag mask.
CFS-method (NI-CFO) preferred over BS-method (DWC) for A-share restatement resilience.
Drop banks/insurers (SW L1 in {银行, 非银金融}) or force industry-neutralize.
2015 bubble year is the worst-year stress test.
Small-cap / newly-listed tilt → require listed > 252d and size filter.
Expect IC to improve with horizon → monthly rebalance is the right frequency.

mechanism_candidates.name: Gross profitability (Novy-Marx 2013)
mechanism_candidates.why: Alternative quality proxy; gross profit / assets; stronger in developed markets, mixed in A-share.
caveats: Heavily industry-driven; must neutralize; IT/consumer dominate top quintile.

mechanism_candidates.name: Standardized Unexpected Earnings (SUE / PEAD)
mechanism_candidates.why: Short-horizon event-driven fundamental signal; complements accruals (which is slow-decay).
caveats: Signal is concentrated in 10-20 day windows around announcements; quarterly rebalance suboptimal.

recommended_focus: Accruals anomaly. Well-documented, Tushare-accessible, orthogonal to existing price-volume book, single dominant mechanism, monthly rebalance aligned with quarterly fundamentals cadence.
